frames.action: Open the App: Meal plan, the week of 2–8 Nov 2026 (loaded time Sun 8 Nov, 08:00).
frames.expected: Seven days with each meal, who eats it and its state; earlier days read-only, today marked.

frames.expected: The check names each guest the dish is wrong for and the ingredient lines behind it.
frames.observed: Maya: Unsafe; Ines: Unsuitable, with the lines named

frames.expected: A modal form with the dish, the members at the table and the guest with her need; nothing is written yet.
The form closes; the meal is on Tuesday and selected, with its guest; a dish wrong for her is planned and flagged, not refused.

frames.expected: The form opens with the saved dish, the people at the table and each guest with her needs; the dish is switched to the variant.

frames.expected: The form names the limit in words and sends nothing.
frames.observed: “Each guest name can be at most 120 characters.”; App version unchanged {"epoch":1,"revision":2}

frames.action: This week, today’s dinner (Chicken noodle soup), “Mark cooked”, tick “Take the ingredients from the pantry”.
